policies.refundIntro: Direct Hub guarantees the buyer's right to a refund under the conditions and cases below.
policies.transparencyTitle: Transparency, financial security, and the triple-code system
policies.transparencyIntro: Direct Hub Global connects buyers directly with factories — from needle to aircraft — with no middlemen and the highest standards of protection and financial security.
fullRefundItems: Product does not match specifications agreed in the negotiation room.
Shipment does not arrive within the contract period without an acceptable reason.
Material manufacturing defects that make the product unusable.
Order cancelled before the factory starts preparation and production.
partialRefundItems: Shortage in shipped quantities versus agreed quantities.
Defects in part of the shipment while the rest is sound.
Delivery delay where the buyer still accepts the goods.
noRefundItems: Buyer changes mind after the factory starts preparation and production.
Buyer accepts delivery and confirms final receipt without objection.
Custom orders produced to special specifications.
refundProcessItems: Open a dispute/complaint via the platform within the inspection window.
Submit supporting evidence, photos, and documents.
DirectHub admin reviews the claim within 3–7 business days.
Release the due amount to the buyer's account via approved channels.

buyerStages.title: Order & product selection
buyerStages.body: Buyer defines needs and negotiates quantities, specs, and prices directly with the factory — no middlemen.

buyerStages.title: Financial security & escrow hold
buyerStages.body: Once the order is confirmed, the buyer pays and funds are held in platform escrow — not released to the factory immediately.

buyerStages.title: Preparation & shipping
buyerStages.body: The factory prepares and ships per negotiated specs and agreed timeline.

buyerStages.title: Inspection & receipt
buyerStages.body: On arrival, the buyer has a defined window to inspect goods before final receipt confirmation.

buyerStages.title: Complaints & objections
buyerStages.body: If defects, shortages, or mismatches are found, the buyer may open a dispute on the platform immediately.

factoryStages.title: Advance financial guarantee
factoryStages.body: Once parties agree, the platform ensures deal funds are already held in escrow before work starts.

factoryStages.title: Earnings & secure transfer
factoryStages.body: After successful delivery and criteria are met, funds are transferred securely to the factory.

factoryStages.title: No arbitrary withdrawal
factoryStages.body: Buyers may not cancel arbitrarily without a valid legal reason after order confirmation and escrow hold.
